steps: Delete the probe grain created for the launch probe.

No external state is created: this app declares no sidecars, so the probe reaches no network service. `go list -deps ./...` over the module resolves exactly one hrbrlife import, github.com/hrbrlife/grain-crypto-journal, and neither the Go source nor sandstorm-pkgdef.capnp references any *.sidecar.host. The grain's state lives only in its own /var.

launchProbe.expectedResult: A human can create one InstaCo series grain and see it render its real first screen under enforced authz, with no further navigation and no PowerBox grant required to reach it.

steps.action: Create a grain with the "New InstaCo series" action and open it.
steps.expectedResult: The series console renders its own first screen; it does not show a shell handshake or lock screen.

steps.action: Read the role indicator on that first screen without navigating anywhere else.
steps.expectedResult: The grain reports the acting principal's role from its own six-bit permission model rather than leaving it blank or defaulting to admin.
